title: Expedition 33 Complete Guide
description: Full guide for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 covering combat, exploration, builds, and boss strategies.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.content: Expedition 33 is a turn-based RPG with real-time action elements. You'll lead a party of characters through a dark fantasy world, battling The Paintress and her creations. This guide covers everything you need to know from early game to endgame. Start by mastering the parry system — it's essential for surviving boss encounters. Build your party around synergies between characters like Maelle (tank/DPS), Verso (support/healer), and Lune (ranged DPS).

sections.title: Combat Basics
sections.content: Combat in Expedition 33 blends turn-based strategy with action timing. Each character has a unique attack pattern that requires precise button presses. Parrying enemy attacks reduces damage and builds your counter gauge. Master the timing window for each enemy type — bosses have distinct visual tells before their attacks. Use the Paint gauge strategically; it charges through successful parries and dealing damage, then unleashes powerful Lumina abilities.

sections.title: Exploration Tips
sections.content: The world of Expedition 33 is filled with hidden Pictos, weapon caches, and lore fragments. Check behind waterfalls and inside ruined structures for rare equipment. Talk to every NPC — some offer side quests that reward unique Pictos not available elsewhere. The interactive map reveals collectible locations after you discover them in-game. Fast travel unlocks at Act 2 via the Chronos Stones scattered throughout each region.
